qs.ours: 1 Pet. i. 13. ¦ f Veluti Buccinctus cursitat hospes.—*Hor, SoL* vi 107. In the Saturnalia of the Romans, the Saccas of the Babylonians, and the Hermaea of the Cretans, the servants sat at table, while their masters waited on them. ¦ *t* Matt. xiv. 25.
